item.title: Meta Opens Muse AI Agent Live Video Calls to All US Users
item.description:
Meta has opened live video calls with its Muse AI agent to all US users, letting them talk to a customizable animated avatar with roughly 870ms response latency. A distilled student model reproduces in two passes what a teacher model needed 120 passes for, and with 4-bit quantization, caching and dynamic batching a single Nvidia GB200 serves 12 concurrent video streams—though serving cost at million-user scale remains the key constraint.

原文标题：Meta 向全美用户开放 Muse AI 智能体实时视频通话

Why it matters：这是 AI 智能体从文本走向实时多模态交互的重要产品化节点，且披露了延迟、并发与成本等可验证的工程细节。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · agent · signal 78/100

item.title: Stanford Paper Finds No Metric Is Fully Tokenizer-Agnostic
item.description:
A new Stanford paper finds that no metric is tokenizer-agnostic in every sense, including bits-per-byte (BPB), which is widely treated as neutral. Untrained models showed different BPB across tokenizers, and BPB correlated with task accuracy only between +0.02 and −0.30. The authors advise checking task accuracy on the same text rather than trusting a single score when comparing tokenizers.

原文标题：斯坦福论文：不存在完全与分词器无关的评估指标

Why it matters：它直接挑战了跨分词器模型比较中被默认接受的 BPB 指标，对做模型评测与词表选择的读者有实际纠偏价值。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · llm · signal 72/100

item.title: OpenAI Unveils GPT-6 Cyber to Find Exploits and Suggest Patches
item.description:
OpenAI has launched GPT-6 Cyber, a model purpose-trained for vulnerability hunting that can find flaws, build working exploits, and propose patches. In targeted tests it surfaced 81 previously unknown critical Firefox vulnerabilities already patched by Mozilla, and in the Linux kernel reproduced 1,724 vulnerabilities with working exploits for 948—more than five times its predecessor.

原文标题：OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Cyber 可挖漏洞并给出修复方案

Why it matters：这是首个专攻攻防一体的前沿安全模型，且附带可验证的大规模真实漏洞数据，对关注 AI 能力边界与安全影响的重度读者极具价值。

The Decoder · llm · signal 86/100

item.title: Half of Proposed US AI Data Center Projects Face Local Scrutiny After Democratic Midterm Wins
item.description:
After Democrats won the House, Senate and key governorships, roughly half of proposed US AI data center additions could face tougher local scrutiny. Traditional safe havens like Texas and Ohio may halt construction pending assurances on water and electricity prices; Meta's president said hyperscalers are now weighing building outside the US, while OpenAI quickly pledged to avoid NDAs and shield residents from power costs.

原文标题：民主党中期选举获胜 半数美国 AI 数据中心项目面临地方审查

Why it matters：政治格局变化直接冲击 AI 算力基建的落地节奏，是算力与产业交叉的重要信号。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · industry · signal 78/100

item.title: Tencent Unveils Hy4 Open-Source LLM with Vision and Computer-Use Capabilities
item.description:
Tencent announced Hy4, its latest open-source large language model, claiming performance that ranks among the world's leading open models. Hy4 adds visual understanding and computer-use capabilities for the first time, alongside gains in instruction following, long-context comprehension and long-horizon agentic tasks. Model weights and system cards are slated for release in the coming days, with Tencent emphasizing responsible open-source development around cybersecurity and biological safety.

原文标题：腾讯发布 Hy4 开源大模型 首次支持视觉理解与电脑操作

Why it matters：头部厂商开源旗舰模型并首次补齐视觉与电脑操作能力，是开源大模型竞争格局中的重要节点。

Hacker News AI · llm · signal 72/100

item.title: TinyFish Launches Two Web Research Agents for Deep Q&A and Bulk Spreadsheets
item.description:
TinyFish released two web research agents: TinyResearch produces a cited report for a single hard question, while TinySet assembles a spreadsheet from facts scattered across hundreds of sites. The pitch is to split deep digging and wide scanning into two distinct agent shapes rather than one generalist. Public details so far are positioning-level, without verifiable metrics on accuracy or coverage.

原文标题：TinyFish 推出两款网页研究智能体 分攻深度问答与批量建表

Why it matters：代表了智能体产品化中“按任务形态拆分”的一种设计取向，值得关注但尚缺硬指标。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · agent · signal 42/100

item.title: Meta Opens Muse AI Avatar Video Chat to All US Users
item.description:
Meta has made Muse Voice generally available in the US, letting users hold real-time voice and video conversations with its consumer AI agent Muse via mobile, web, and Mac. The feature is powered by the new Muse Realtime Avatar and Muse Realtime Voice models, with planned expansion to AI Glasses and the upcoming Muse Charm device.

原文标题：Meta 向全美用户开放 Muse AI 虚拟形象视频通话

Why it matters：这是消费级 AI 智能体在实时多模态交互形态上的一次规模化落地，值得关注其产品化路径。

TechCrunch AI · agent · signal 58/100

item.title: NVIDIA Open-Sources Cosmos 3 World Models for Interactive Simulation
item.description:
NVIDIA released the Cosmos 3 family of open world models on Hugging Face, targeting interactive world simulation with public checkpoints and example collections. The release extends the Cosmos world-foundation-model line, opening physical-world modeling to developers for simulation data generation in robotics and autonomous driving.

原文标题：NVIDIA 开源 Cosmos 3 世界模型 支持交互式仿真

Why it matters：头部厂商开源世界模型并配套检查点，直接影响仿真数据与具身智能研发路径。

Hugging Face Blog · llm · signal 78/100

item.title: OpenRouter Fixes Crouton Alpha Bug That Halted Agents Mid-Task
item.description:
OpenRouter fixed a bug in its stealth reasoning model Crouton Alpha that caused agents to stop early, typically right before a tool call; agents should now run tasks to completion. The model was previously announced as free to use with a 1M-token context, text/image/audio/video input, and no training on user data.

原文标题：OpenRouter 修复 Crouton Alpha 智能体中途停止的缺陷

Why it matters：这是一次针对智能体执行中断的常规缺陷修复，对正在试用该隐身模型的开发者有直接参考价值。

OpenRouter (@OpenRouter) · llm · signal 38/100

item.title: webAI Open-Sources TwIL-8B, a Small Model Approaching Frontier Coding and Math
item.description:
webAI has open-sourced TwIL-8B, an 8.8B-parameter model built on IBM's Granite 4.2 8B and tuned for math, coding and instruction following. It reportedly fits in a 4.98 GiB quantized file that runs on CPUs or modest GPUs, scoring 81.6% on LiveCodeBench and reaching roughly 92-93% of frontier-model performance on coding and instruction following.

原文标题：webAI 开源 TwIL-8B 小模型逼近前沿编程与数学能力

Why it matters：小参数模型在编程与数学基准上逼近前沿闭源模型，且可在消费级硬件本地运行，对关注端侧部署与开源模型的读者价值较高。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · llm · signal 78/100

item.title: Meta Executive Warns Midterm Backlash Against Data Centers Could Slow AI Expansion
item.description:
Meta President Dina Powell McCormick said at the WSJ Tech conference that Democratic midterm wins will make data center construction significantly harder, acknowledging the industry has failed to explain the benefits of these investments. She framed local opposition as a symptom of broader public unease about AI, and said Meta aims to reverse sentiment by demonstrating value, while noting strong daily demand to lease its compute provides a monetization path regardless.

原文标题：Meta 高管警告：中期选举后数据中心遭抵制将拖慢 AI 扩张

Why it matters：这是大厂高管对 AI 基础设施政治阻力与算力变现路径的公开表态，反映产业扩张面临的现实约束。

TechCrunch AI · industry · signal 58/100

item.title: OpenAI Opens Security Model That Found Severe Ubuntu Flaw in Two Hours
item.description:
OpenAI is giving cybersecurity defenders access to frontier models through its Daybreak Blue program, and one developer used GPT 5.6 Sol to surface a severe Ubuntu server vulnerability in about two hours; Debian has since patched it. The episode shows LLM-driven vulnerability discovery is now practical, while the piece argues the industry still lacks urgency for patching critical digital infrastructure.

原文标题：OpenAI 开放安全模型 两小时挖出 Ubuntu 高危漏洞

Why it matters：这是大模型在真实安全场景中产出可验证漏洞的落地案例，对关注模型能力边界的读者有直接参考价值。

TechCrunch AI · llm · signal 72/100

item.title: Google Releases Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash with 15-Second Clips and 30% Price Cut
item.description:
Google DeepMind has made Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generally available, extending clip length from 10 to 15 seconds and adding conversational editing. The model costs 30% less than its predecessor and ships across the Gemini API, AI Studio, Flow, Google Vids and other surfaces, with every output carrying an imperceptible SynthID watermark.

原文标题：Google Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash 发布：视频时长延至 15 秒，价格降 30%

Why it matters：主流厂商视频生成模型在时长、编辑交互与价格三个维度同时推进，是评估多模态生成成本曲线的重要节点。

item.title: Science's Last Exam Benchmark Grades AI Research Agents With Hidden Expert Checks
item.description:
The US nonprofit AItonomy Foundation released Science's Last Exam (SLE), a benchmark spanning 113 tasks across 9 disciplines that hands agents real research goals, data and lab software, then grades them with expert checks the agent never sees, comparing hypotheses against studies published after model training cutoffs. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash led with 21.28% of hypotheses anticipating later research, while all models scored zero on true end-to-end research.

原文标题：Science's Last Exam 基准发布 用隐藏专家检查评测 AI 科研能力

Why it matters：它把数学领域可复现的自动评分思路迁移到实证科学，用隐藏检查与训练截止后文献构建抗记忆的科研智能体评测，结果对模型能力判断有直接参考价值。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · llm · signal 78/100

item.title: Meta Adds Real-Time Voice Mode and Expressive Avatars to Muse Agent
item.description:
Meta has rolled out real-time voice conversations to its Muse AI agent, with avatars animating in sync with speech and voice tone adjustable via natural language or settings. The feature is live on iOS, with Meta promising expansion to its AI glasses and the forthcoming Muse Charm device later this year.

原文标题：Meta 为 Muse 智能体上线实时语音对话与动态头像

Why it matters：这是 Meta 在消费级 AI 智能体交互形态上的重要产品动作，语音与动态头像结合值得关注。

The Verge AI · product_launch · signal 58/100

item.title: Developer Argues Codex's Computer Use Beats Claude Code
item.description:
Developer Yuchen Jin argues that Codex's key edge over Claude Code is computer use: APIs and MCPs are slow, and legacy enterprise UIs are hard for humans to navigate. Codex operated a confusing expense-reimbursement app and finished the task in minutes, effectively turning any UI into an API. The claim rests on personal experience without quantitative evidence.

原文标题：开发者称 Codex 的计算机使用能力优于 Claude Code

Why it matters：以具体案例说明计算机使用代理在传统企业软件场景中的实用价值，对关注 Agent 落地的读者有参考意义。

Yuchen Jin (@Yuchenj_UW) · agent · signal 38/100

item.title: Verne Robotics Open-Sources V0.5 World Action Model with Stronger Robustness
item.description:
Verne Robotics released V0.5, an open-weight world action model built on the Wan2.2 video generator and trained on over 1.7M demonstrations, predicting the next second of arm, gripper and mobile-base motion. It learns new industrial tasks from under two hours of demos and degrades far less than Physical Intelligence's π0.5 under clutter and lighting shifts.

原文标题：Verne Robotics 开源 V0.5 世界动作模型 抗干扰能力显著领先

Why it matters：开源权重机器人基础模型在鲁棒性基准上明显领先闭源对手，且数据效率突出，值得关注。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · llm · signal 78/100

item.title: Meta Adds NTS Authentication to Public Time Service, Open Sources Stack
item.description:
Meta's public time service at nts.meta.com now supports NTS (RFC 8915), letting clients verify that time packets came from Meta and were not modified in transit. The NTS servers are stateless, with cookie keys derived rather than stored or replicated, and the protocol, server and client code are open sourced on GitHub.

原文标题：Meta 时间服务上线 NTS 并开源协议与客户端

Why it matters：为长期未认证的 NTP 补上来源验证，且整套实现开源，对基础设施与安全工程师有直接参考价值。

Hacker News AI · opensource · signal 58/100

item.title: Google Paper Finds Query Echoing Is Key to RAG Poisoning
item.description:
A new Google paper shows that RAG poisoning hinges less on the attack payload than on echoing the user's query so poisoned documents get retrieved. Across 623 queries, just 5 documents (about 0.1% of the corpus) degraded classic retriever ranking quality by 40.2% to 61.5%; filtering query-echoing documents blocked the attack but halved clean ranking quality on NFCorpus from 0.267 to 0.134.

原文标题：谷歌新论文揭示 RAG 投毒关键：复制用户查询即可污染检索

Why it matters：首次量化揭示 RAG 检索层投毒的低成本与防御代价，对构建检索增强系统的开发者有直接安全警示价值。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · llm · signal 78/100

item.title: Viktor AI Agent Adds Email Interface with Sender-Identity Access Control
item.description:
AI agent Viktor has moved from requiring a Slack or Teams install to offering a public email address, letting anyone assign tasks or book meetings by emailing or CC-ing it. Since the address is shared, access is gated by authenticated sender identity, so the agent only acts on mail from the actual user. The case suggests email, with its built-in context and identity, may be a natural interface for agents.

原文标题：Viktor 智能体新增邮箱入口 以发件人身份控制访问权限

Why it matters：展示了以邮箱和发件人身份作为智能体接入与权限边界的一种新交互范式，对关注 Agent 落地形态的读者有参考价值。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · agent · signal 58/100

item.title: Amazon Uses SageMaker AI Multi-Model Fusion to Score A+ Content Quality
item.description:
Amazon describes a multi-model fusion approach built on SageMaker AI to evaluate the holistic quality of A+ Content, where text, images, and video are judged together rather than asset by asset. It is a vendor-bound engineering practice write-up aimed at heterogeneous multi-module content, without disclosed model parameters or reproducible benchmark data.

原文标题：亚马逊用 SageMaker AI 多模型融合评估 A+ 内容质量

Why it matters：展示了大厂用多模型融合做内容质量评估的落地思路，但属厂商绑定实践分享，缺乏可复现细节。

AWS Machine Learning Blog · tools · signal 38/100

item.title: OpenAI President Says Company Could Be IPO-Ready by 2027
item.description:
OpenAI president Greg Brockman said at a WSJ tech conference that the company could be ready for an IPO in 2027, citing growing enterprise revenue. He acknowledged a rough first half of 2026 and lagging Anthropic's Claude Code in agentic coding, but said OpenAI's enterprise standing has shifted markedly since.

原文标题：OpenAI 总裁称公司有望 2027 年具备 IPO 条件

Why it matters：这是 OpenAI 上市时间表与企业战略转向的关键信号，对判断其商业化节奏与竞争格局有参考价值。

TechCrunch AI · industry · signal 58/100

item.title: Nasdaq Sinks 5% as Investors Retreat From AI Trade After Election
item.description:
Investors pulled back from the crowded AI trade after the U.S. election, driving the Nasdaq down 5% in a single session while the VIX spiked more than 62% and Bitcoin fell about 5%. The move signals a shift from one-sided AI positioning toward risk repricing, making volatility and capital rotation key variables for AI asset valuations.

原文标题：大选后投资者撤离 AI 交易 纳指单日重挫 5%

Why it matters：这是 AI 板块资金面与市场情绪的宏观信号，直接影响 AI 公司估值与融资环境。

Hacker News AI · industry · signal 62/100

item.title: Claude 接入银行账户 推出个人财务分析功能
item.description:
Anthropic 为 Claude 推出个人财务功能，通过 Plaid 以只读方式连接银行与信用卡账户，可生成按类别划分的支出概览并回答账单、大额消费承受力等问题。Claude 无法转账、管理或投资资金，也不提供投资建议，但可读取账户名称、余额、信用额度及最长两年的交易记录。

Why it matters：这是大模型助手首次以受监管的只读方式接入真实金融账户，标志着 Agent 落地高敏感场景的重要一步。

The Verge AI · tools · signal 58/100

item.title: Anthropic Adds Personal Finance Tool to Claude With Bank Account Access
item.description:
Anthropic launched Personal Finance for Claude, letting users link bank and credit card accounts read-only via Plaid and ask questions about balances, transactions and spending in plain language. The tool cannot move or invest money, and marks another vertical push for Claude, though it trails ChatGPT's similar finance feature launched in May.

原文标题：Claude 推出个人理财工具 可直连银行账户分析消费

Why it matters：这是 Claude 向个人理财垂直场景延伸的产品动作，涉及账户连接与只读权限设计，但缺乏模型能力层面的实质突破。

TechCrunch AI · tools · signal 58/100

item.title: OpenRouter 发布 Ori 配置手册 借助 MDM 让 API 密钥远离开发者设备
item.description:
OpenRouter 发布了一份新配置手册，指导用户结合 MDM（移动设备管理）部署 Ori，使开发者只需在终端登录即可调用，无需在本地保存长期 API 密钥，从而降低恶意包窃取密钥的风险。该内容属于面向厂商绑定场景的操作指南，聚焦密钥管理与终端安全实践，未涉及模型能力或性能数据。

Why it matters：对使用 OpenRouter 与 MDM 的团队有直接可操作性，但属厂商绑定操作指南，注意力权重有限。

OpenRouter (@OpenRouter) · tools · signal 38/100

item.title: 百度开源 2800 亿参数 ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base 基础模型
item.description:
百度在 Hugging Face 发布 ERNIE-5.5-Flash-Base，采用混合专家架构，总参数 2800 亿、每 token 激活 140 亿，预训练语料 33.5 万亿 token，训练上下文 12.8 万 token，微调与推理阶段可扩展至百万级上下文。该模型刻意不做微调与后训练，定位为供开发者自行定制的基础权重，后续将推出后训练版本。

Why it matters：大厂开源超大参数基础模型权重，直接影响开源模型选型与二次训练路线。

The Decoder · llm · signal 78/100

item.title: BOSS 直聘团队开源 Nanbeige4.3-33B 推理模型，综合智能追平 Qwen3.8 27B
item.description:
BOSS 直聘旗下基础模型团队 Nanbeige 以 Apache 2.0 协议开源 33B 稠密推理模型 Nanbeige4.3-33B，在 Artificial Analysis 智能指数 v5 上得 20 分，与 Qwen3.8 27B（xhigh）持平。该模型支持 524K token 上下文、仅文本输入输出，体积小到可在笔记本本地运行，终端操作与物理推理为相对强项，但知识类基准明显落后。

Why it matters：30B 级开源稠密推理模型在综合智能上追平 Qwen3.8 27B，且可本地运行，对关注开源模型选型的读者有直接参考价值。

Artificial Analysis (@ArtificialAnlys) · llm · signal 72/100

item.title: OpenRouter：2026 年智能体缓存命中率升至 89%
item.description:
OpenRouter 指出，2026 年推理层的进步同样显著：智能体场景的中位缓存命中率从年初的 60% 多升至 89%，同等模型下成本明显下降。这意味着在模型能力之外，推理基础设施的缓存优化正成为降本的关键变量。

Why it matters：来自主流模型路由平台的实测口径数据，量化了推理层缓存优化对智能体成本的实质影响。

OpenRouter (@OpenRouter) · compute · signal 58/100

item.title: Eon 推出 Yukon 无服务器数据引擎 面向智能体数据层
item.description:
Eon 发布 Yukon 无服务器数据引擎，将事件数据摄取、清洗并压缩为自有存储桶中的开放 Iceberg 表，智能体通过 MCP 读取表上下文。官方公开基准显示其计算开销比 Spark 低 4 倍、比 Flink 低 7 倍，核心思路是让智能体在查询前先了解表结构以减少无效扫描。

Why it matters：智能体数据层是当前落地瓶颈之一，该产品给出可复现的公开基准与开放表格式方案，值得关注。

Rohan Paul (@rohanpaul_ai) · tools · signal 58/100
